title: Hosea Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Hosea 5: the judgment against priests and king, Ephraim turning to Assyria, and Yahweh returning to his place.

questions.text: At which two places does the chapter say they have been a snare and a spread net?
questions.explanation: The verse says the priests, the house of Israel and the house of the king have been a snare at Mizpah and a net spread on Tabor.

answers.text: A snare at Mizpah and a net on Tabor
A snare at Gilgal and a net on Carmel
A snare at Gibeah and a net on Ramah
A snare at Bethel and a net on Gilead

questions.text: What does Yahweh say about Ephraim and Israel in this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me, and that Ephraim has played the prostitute and Israel is defiled.

answers.text: He has forgotten Ephraim, and Israel is far from him
He has chosen Ephraim, and Israel is pleasing to him
He knows Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from him
He has hidden Ephraim, and Israel is kept safe

questions.text: What does this chapter say is within them, so that they do not know Yahweh?
questions.explanation: The verse says their deeds will not allow them to turn to their God, for the spirit of prostitution is within them and they do not know Yahweh.

answers.text: The pride of their fathers
The spirit of prostitution
A lying tongue in their mouth
A heart of stone within them

questions.text: With what will they go to seek Yahweh, and what will happen?
questions.explanation: The verse says they will go with their flocks and herds to seek Yahweh, but they will not find him, for he has withdrawn himself from them.

answers.text: With silver and gold, and he will answer them
With fasting and weeping, and he will heal them
With incense and oil, but he will refuse it
With flocks and herds, but they will not find him

questions.text: Where is the cornet to be blown and the trumpet sounded, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says blow the cornet in Gibeah and the trumpet in Ramah, and sound a battle cry at Beth Aven.

answers.text: The cornet in Gibeah and the trumpet in Ramah
The cornet in Mizpah and the trumpet on Tabor
The cornet in Gilgal and the trumpet in Bethel
The cornet in Samaria and the trumpet in Shechem

questions.text: What are the princes of Judah compared with in this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says the princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark, and that he will pour out his wrath on them like water.

answers.text: Those who break down a wall
Those who hide a treasure
Those who remove a landmark
Those who sell their brothers

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he is to Ephraim and to the house of Judah in this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says he is to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.

answers.text: Like a shepherd to Ephraim, and like a guard to Judah
Like a moth to Ephraim, and like rottenness to Judah
Like a cloud to Ephraim, and like dew to Judah
Like a wall to Ephraim, and like a tower to Judah

questions.text: Where did Ephraim go when he saw his sickness?
questions.explanation: The verse says that when Ephraim saw his sickness and Judah his wound, Ephraim went to Assyria and sent to king Jareb, who is not able to heal them.

answers.text: To Egypt, and he sent to its princes
To Gilead, and he sent to its elders
To Samaria, and he sent to its priests
To Assyria, and he sent to king Jareb

questions.text: What animal does Yahweh say he will be to Ephraim in this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says he will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah, tearing in pieces with no one to deliver.

answers.text: Like a lion
Like a bear
Like an eagle
Like a wolf

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will do until they acknowledge their offense?
questions.explanation: The verse says he will go and return to his place until they acknowledge their offense and seek his face, and in their affliction they will seek him earnestly.

answers.text: He will send a prophet to warn them
He will break down their altars
He will go and return to his place
He will withhold the rain from their fields
